Class VaultStore

java.lang.Object
org.aetheris.vault.VaultStore
public final class VaultStore extends Object
The VaultStore class is the H2 vault for the shell process. The store talks to H2 with JDBC statements and a Hikari pool. The default store is a file. The ram store is the in-memory vault used for testing. open() creates the tables and migrates missing columns. A later load() selects the canvases. Version 2 is the group_id column and the execution_status column. A caller loads canvases, saves cells, and deletes turns through this type. // @aa-sdd G-12 aetheris-stages-1-3.finalize.md

  • Constructor Details

    • VaultStore

      public VaultStore(AetherisYaml yaml, String username)
      The constructor stores the yaml and the sanitized user name. A null yaml becomes a fresh AetherisYaml. A null user name is sanitized as empty. RegionOwner.sanitize(String) supplies the stored name. An IllegalArgumentException from that sanitize stores anon. The ram flag comes from AetherisYaml.isRamVault().
      Parameters:
      yaml - The yaml is the parsed aetheris settings, or null.
      username - The user name is the SSH user, or null.

    • open

      public void open() throws SQLException
      The open method opens the pool and applies the table statements. The driver name is org.h2.Driver. The ram URL is jdbc:h2:mem:aetheris;DB_CLOSE_DELAY=-1. The file URL is jdbc:h2:file: plus the absolute path of vault under diskDir(). A missing disk directory is created. Backslashes in that path become slashes. The database user is sa. The password is empty. The pool size is AetherisYaml.getPoolMax(), and a size below 1 becomes 1. The pool name is aetheris-vault. The method then runs the workspace, canvas, cell, and trace statements from VaultSql. It adds collapsed and head_lock when those columns are missing. It then runs ensureSchemaVersion(Connection).
      Throws:
      SQLException - The exception is a failure to open the pool or to run a statement.

    • close

      public void close()
      The close method closes the pool. A store that was never opened returns without closing. The pool field becomes null after a close.

    • loadOrCreate

      public List<CanvasRecord> loadOrCreate() throws SQLException
      The loadOrCreate method returns the canvases, creating the first ones when none exist. A load() that already has a canvas returns that list. An empty load inserts a workspace named default for this user. That insert also creates a canvas named Canvas 1. The canvas order starts as the id of one new included cell. The method then loads again and returns that list.
      Returns:
      The return value is the canvases with their cells.
      Throws:
      SQLException - The exception is a JDBC failure.

      Throws:

    • replaceCanvas

      public List<CellRecord> replaceCanvas(String canvasId, List<String> prompts, List<String> replies) throws SQLException
      The replaceCanvas method replaces every turn on one canvas. A null prompt list throws SQLException. A null reply list throws the same exception. Lists of different lengths throw the same exception. The message is replace failed: the table is not a message table. The copy is one transaction. Trace rows for the canvas are deleted. The old cells are deleted. An empty prompt list leaves one empty included cell. Any other list inserts one cell per pair, in order. A null prompt is stored as empty. A null reply is stored as empty. A failure rolls the transaction back. The thrown failure is the one the caller sees.
      Parameters:
      canvasId - The canvas id is the canvas to replace.
      prompts - The prompts are the cell prompts, paired with replies.
      replies - The replies are the cell replies.
      Returns:
      The return value is the new cells, in order.
      Throws:
      SQLException - The exception is a JDBC failure, or the two lists disagree.

    • deleteTurn

      public void deleteTurn(String canvasId, String cellId, List<CellRecord> remaining) throws SQLException
      The deleteTurn method removes one cell on this canvas. The call is deleteTurns(String, List, List) with that single id. Trace rows for that id go with it. The cells that remain store turn indexes from 1, in this order. Parent pointers are not rewritten. Prompt text is not rewritten.
      Parameters:
      canvasId - The canvas id is the canvas that owns the row.
      cellId - The cell id is the row to remove.
      remaining - The remaining cells stay, in canvas order.
      Throws:
      SQLException - The exception is a JDBC failure.

    • deleteTurns

      public void deleteTurns(String canvasId, List<String> cellIds, List<CellRecord> remaining) throws SQLException
      The deleteTurns method removes each id on this canvas in one transaction. A null id list skips the deletes. A null id is skipped. An empty id is skipped. Trace rows for a removed id are deleted. The cell delete matches both the cell id and the canvas id. Each remaining cell stores a turn index from 1 in list order. A null remaining list writes an empty canvas order. Parent pointers are not rewritten. Prompt text is not rewritten. The canvas cell_order becomes the remaining ids. A failure rolls the transaction back.
      Parameters:
      canvasId - The canvas id is the canvas that owns the rows.
      cellIds - The cell ids are the rows to remove.
      remaining - The remaining cells stay, in canvas order.
      Throws:
      SQLException - The exception is a JDBC failure.

      private void ensureCollapsedColumn(Statement st) throws SQLException
      The ensureCollapsedColumn method adds collapsed when that column is missing. The probe reads INFORMATION_SCHEMA.COLUMNS for CELL and COLLAPSED. A probe row means the column is already present. A missing row runs the alter that adds a boolean defaulting to false.
      Parameters:
      st - The statement is an open statement on this vault.
      Throws:
      SQLException - The exception is a JDBC failure.

      private void ensureHeadLockColumn(Statement st) throws SQLException
      The ensureHeadLockColumn method adds head_lock when that column is missing. The probe reads INFORMATION_SCHEMA.COLUMNS for CELL and HEAD_LOCK. A probe row means the column is already present. A missing row runs the alter that adds a boolean defaulting to false.
      Parameters:
      st - The statement is an open statement on this vault.
      Throws:
      SQLException - The exception is a JDBC failure.

    • ensureSchemaVersion

      private void ensureSchemaVersion(Connection c) throws SQLException
      The ensureSchemaVersion method records schema version 2. The method creates schema_version when that table is missing. Version 1 is the tables and no version row. A missing row is read as version 0. A version below 2 adds group_id and execution_status. A version row that names 2 while a column is missing runs those alters again. A column that is still missing throws SQLException. The message is vault version 2 columns are missing. A successful alter writes version 2 on row id 1.
      Parameters:
      c - The connection is an open connection on this vault.
      Throws:
      SQLException - The exception is a JDBC failure, or the version-2 columns are still missing.

    • search

      public List<String> search(String canvasId, String needle) throws SQLException
      The search method returns cell ids whose text contains the needle. A null canvas id returns no ids. An empty canvas id returns no ids. A null needle returns no ids. An empty needle returns no ids. The match uses LIKE with escape \ on user_clob and assistant_clob. A typed % stays a literal. A typed _ stays a literal.
      Parameters:
      canvasId - The canvas id is the open canvas.
      needle - The needle is the operator text.
      Returns:
      The return value is the matching cell ids.
      Throws:
      SQLException - The exception is a JDBC failure.

      public void insertTrace(String cellId, String toolName, String outcome) throws SQLException
      The insertTrace method stores one trace row for a tool outcome. A burner cell does not call this method. A null tool name is stored as empty. A null outcome is stored as empty. The body is tool: plus the name, a newline, outcome: , and the outcome word.
      Parameters:
      cellId - The cell id is the cell that owns the trace.
      toolName - The tool name is the tool.
      outcome - The outcome is the short outcome word.
      Throws:
      SQLException - The exception is a JDBC failure.

    • loadCells

      private void loadCells(Connection c, CanvasRecord canvas) throws SQLException
      The loadCells method fills one canvas from VaultSql.SELECT_CELLS_V2. An empty branch id becomes main. CellState.knownToken(String) sets readable. CellState.fromToken(String) sets the state. collapsed and head_lock are copied from the row. An ephemeral cell loads empty user text and empty assistant text. A null parent id, group id, or execution status becomes empty.
      Parameters:
      c - The connection is an open connection on this vault.
      canvas - The canvas receives the cells.
      Throws:
      SQLException - The exception is a JDBC failure.
